Standard, Deep, or something more?

Standard Cleaning maintains a space that is already under regular care. Deep Cleaning adds more detail, buildup removal and attention to areas everyday maintenance may not reach. Add-ons and reset services let us tailor the project without forcing you into the wrong package.

How pricing works

We price the project. Not the clock.

Your estimate is based on the actual property, service type and scope. We focus on completing the agreed project correctly — not on running up hours.

Square footage
Bedrooms & bathrooms
Condition & buildup
Frequency
Pets / usage
Add-ons & special requests
Weekly

Less buildup and more consistent maintenance.

Biweekly

Our most balanced recurring rhythm for many homes.

Monthly

Longer intervals usually require more reset work each visit.

Custom projects

Airbnb reconfiguration, organization, visual refresh and commercial work are quoted by scope.
